meta.note: Editable default commercial tariffs for the Roof-to-Grid simulator. LES and OPPD figures are from published 2026 rate schedules (effective Jan 1, 2026). ComEd, MidAmerican, Evergy, Xcel Colorado, Xcel South Dakota, Ameren Missouri and Rocky Mountain Power figures are planning estimates — verify against the current tariff book before quoting a customer. Ameren 3(M) and Xcel CO SG splits are from their published tariff sheets; Xcel SD and RMP WY splits are blended planning values grounded in each utility's EIA-861 commercial average. Energy rates are blended $/kWh; demand charges are $/kW-month. All values are editable in the app.

sources.Ameren Missouri: Ameren Schedule 3(M) Large General Service, eff. Aug 17, 2025 — demand $7.43/kW summer, $2.76/kW winter; declining-block energy ~6-12c summer, ~4.5-7.7c winter
sources.LES: les.com/rates/business-rates — General Service-Demand (11/12), Large Light & Power (15/16/39), effective Jan 1, 2026
sources.OPPD: OPPD Rate Manual, Resolution No. 6743, effective Jan 1, 2026 — Rate 231 (small demand), Rate 230 (non-demand)
sources.Rocky Mountain Power WY: RMP Schedule 46 (Large General Service TOU, >=1,000 kW), eff. Nov 17, 2025 — on-peak demand $19.02/kW + facilities $4.21/kW + load size $1.80/kW; energy under 1c/kWh base. RMP commercial averaged 11.75c/kWh all-in (EIA-861, 2025).
sources.Xcel Colorado: PSCo Schedule SG, 2024 tariff — distribution demand $9.36/kW + G&T demand $15.14/kW summer, $9.09/kW winter
sources.Xcel South Dakota: Xcel SD commercial averaged 10.79c/kWh all-in (EIA-861, 2025); General Service is demand-metered above 25 kW
